title: KreadoAI review: pricing, avatars, API & alternatives
summary: KreadoAI explained: free limits, current pricing, K-coins, talking photos, avatar cloning, API access, limitations and four alternatives.
body_markdown:
**KreadoAI is an AI-avatar video platform for turning a script, photo, product URL, or presentation into presenter-led video. Its best fit is multilingual marketing, training, product-demo, and talking-photo production. A free account currently includes 180 K-coins and three video minutes; paid access adds more avatars, voices, commercial-use rights, watermark removal, longer limits, and API access on Pro.**


KreadoAI is worth testing when the presenter is the format. Start with another tool when you need cinematic scene generation, detailed timeline editing, or a general video editor around the avatar. Its K-coin system, plan limits, and separate avatar types also make a small real-workflow test more useful than comparing feature counts.


We checked KreadoAI's product, pricing, avatar, talking-photo, and API documentation on September 12, 2026. We did not run a controlled output-quality, lip-sync, or speed benchmark. Provider claims are attributed, and the test below shows how to evaluate the tool with your own script and portrait.


## KreadoAI at a glance


- **Best for:** script-led videos with a stock, photo-based, or cloned digital presenter
- **Inputs:** text, photo, audio, PowerPoint/PDF, and product URL, depending on the workflow
- **Free access:** the current homepage lists 180 K-coins, three total video minutes, five avatars, 120+ voices, and 31 languages
- **Paid plans:** the homepage currently displays Premium at $19/month and Pro at $40/month as promotional prices
- **Talking Photo:** upload a still portrait, then use typed speech or audio to animate it
- **Avatar cloning:** instant self-service cloning and a separate $499 professional avatar-and-voice service are documented
- **API:** available to Professional/Pro users; the help center documents one concurrent task by default and a queue of eight
- **Main caveat:** the pricing page is dynamic and currently exposes inconsistent free-credit figures, so verify the checkout and account allowance before budgeting


## What is KreadoAI?


[KreadoAI](https://www.kreadoai.com/) is a browser-based video platform centered on digital presenters. Its current product menu includes AI spokesperson videos, talking photos, avatar and voice cloning, text-to-speech, presentation-to-video, URL-to-video, translation, captions, and ad-creative workflows.


The important distinction is the source of the presenter:


- A **stock avatar** is selected from KreadoAI's library.
- A **talking photo** animates one uploaded still image.
- An **instant avatar clone** starts from a short personal video.
- A **professional avatar clone** is a paid, reviewed service built from longer recorded material.


These routes have different setup, motion, voice, pricing, and rights implications. Decide which presenter type you need before comparing plans.

## KreadoAI pricing in September 2026


KreadoAI uses **K-coins** , a virtual currency deducted by the selected generation workflow. The current homepage displays these monthly offers:


- **Free:** $0, 180 K-coins, three total video minutes, five AI avatars, 120+ voices in 31 languages, and one instant avatar clone.
- **Premium:** a displayed promotional price of $19/month, 1,800 monthly K-coins, 30 video minutes, 700+ avatars, voices in 140 languages, and ten instant avatar clones.
- **Pro:** a displayed promotional price of $40/month, 3,000 monthly K-coins, 50 video minutes, 1,000+ avatars, voices in 140 languages, unlimited instant avatar clones, and API access.
- **Enterprise:** custom terms.


The dedicated[pricing page](https://www.kreadoai.com/price) does not reliably render every paid price in its public HTML. It also shows ten free K-coins in one card while its FAQ says new users receive 180 K-coins for 30 days; the homepage also says 180. Treat the logged-in account and checkout as the source for the amount you will actually receive.


KreadoAI says membership K-coins reset each billing cycle and do not roll over. Separately purchased K-coins expire after 30, 60, or 90 days depending on the pack. Paid plans list 1080p export, commercial-use rights, watermark removal, more avatars, longer duration, and faster processing. Save the checkout screen and confirm taxes, renewal, K-coin expiration, included avatar tier, output minutes, and cancellation terms before paying.


## Digital-human video workflow and limits


KreadoAI's[digital-human video FAQ](https://help.kreadoai.com/en/articles/8696920-digital-human-video-faq) describes script limits of 800 characters for free users, 2,400 for Premium, and 5,000 for Professional. The provider estimates those amounts at about one, three, and ten minutes of speech, but actual duration depends on language, voice, punctuation, and speaking speed.


The same page says one scene can be up to ten minutes and recommends splitting long work into five-to-eight-minute scenes. It estimates five to ten minutes of generation time for a one-minute video, while its separate API FAQ gives an approximate four minutes per generated minute. Those are provider estimates from different workflows, not a guaranteed speed benchmark.


For a real project, test the exact language, voice, avatar type, script length, and export settings. A five-second English sample with a stock avatar does not establish how a ten-minute translated training video will perform.


## Talking Photo


KreadoAI's[Talking Photo FAQ](https://help.kreadoai.com/en/articles/8697218-talking-photo-faq) says the tool animates a still image from a script and voice. The page advertises more than 140 languages and 1,600 voices, while the current pricing page advertises a much larger voice library for paid plans. Because these first-party pages disagree, verify the language and exact voice inside the current picker.


The help center says Talking Photo uses one K-coin per generated second in its ordinary avatar workflow: 60 seconds costs 60 K-coins and 90 seconds costs 90. It also says the free account provides three Talking Photo trials. Check the live generation quote, because avatar tiers and product changes can affect consumption.


Use a front-facing, well-lit portrait with a visible mouth and clean edges. Review teeth, blinks, head motion, hair, earrings, eyeglasses, the first and final phonemes, pauses, and every proper noun in the exported result.


## Instant and professional avatar cloning


The digital-human FAQ says Instant Clone can start from a personal video of at least five seconds. The pricing page lists one instant clone on Free, ten on Premium, and unlimited instant clones on Pro. These are account allowances, not proof that every source video will produce an acceptable result.


KreadoAI also documents a separate[professional avatar-and-voice clone](https://help.kreadoai.com/en/articles/8727252-avatar-clone-faq) for $499 as a one-time service. The provider requests a five-minute recording, reviews submissions for legality, and says approved clones usually appear one to two working days later. Its current terms require the uploader to own or control the supplied image, video, and voice material.


Only clone a person who has given informed permission for the intended use. Record that consent, restrict account access, and review every generated claim and endorsement before publishing.


## Does KreadoAI have an API?


Yes. The[KreadoAI API page](https://www.kreadoai.com/openapi) presents digital-avatar and text-to-video integration, and the[API help page](https://help.kreadoai.com/en/articles/10271922-kreadoai-api-docs) links to the developer documentation.


The help center currently documents:


- API access for Professional/Pro users rather than free accounts
- one concurrent generation task by default
- a queue of up to eight tasks
- an approximate four minutes to generate one minute of video
- a Pro example of $0.50 per generated minute
- one K-coin per second for a Premium avatar and two per second for a Supreme avatar
- refunds of K-coins for failed generation attempts


These are provider-documented defaults and examples, not a production service-level agreement. Before integrating, confirm the current endpoint contract, allowed avatar types, authentication, callback verification, concurrency, retries, failure billing, retention, moderation, commercial terms, and a current quote.


## What KreadoAI does not replace


KreadoAI assembles presenter-led video, but that does not make it a full nonlinear editor or a general cinematic video model. You may still need a separate editor for precise cuts, layered motion graphics, color, audio mixing, source citations, legal captions, and frame-level repair.


Its published avatar, voice, and language counts also describe catalog access, not output quality. A large library cannot answer whether one specific presenter speaks one specific script naturally enough for your brand.


## A fair 15-minute KreadoAI test


Use one 80-to-120-word script from the actual job. Include a proper noun, a number, a short pause, and the hardest sentence you expect the presenter to say. Use the same script, portrait, audio level, aspect ratio, and target resolution when comparing another service.


Create one stock-avatar version and, if relevant, one Talking Photo or instant-clone version. Record the plan, avatar type, language, voice, K-coins quoted and charged, queue time, failures, and export settings.


Each output should pass these checks:


1. Every word, name, number, pause, and emphasis is correct.
2. Lip movement stays aligned through plosives, pauses, and the final word.
3. Eyes, teeth, hair, glasses, and face edges remain stable.
4. The presenter remains visually consistent across scenes and cuts.
5. Captions match the spoken track and stay within the frame.
6. The export has the expected duration, resolution, aspect ratio, audio, and watermark state.
7. The plan grants the required commercial use and the presenter has consented.
8. No defect requires regeneration before the intended publication.


Calculate K-coins, elapsed time, and human review time per accepted minute. Keep rejected generations in the denominator.


## Best KreadoAI alternatives by job


### Magic Hour: talking portraits plus broader media tools


[Magic Hour Talking Photo](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-talking-photo) is the direct starting point when you want to upload a portrait and make it speak, then continue into face swap, lip sync, animation, image, or video workflows in the same broader tool suite.


### HeyGen: business presenters and localization


[HeyGen](https://www.heygen.com/) is the closest comparison when presenter video, localization, shared templates, and team production are the main purchase criteria. Compare the precise creator-app plan and API separately.


### Synthesia: governed training and enablement


[Synthesia](https://www.synthesia.io/) is relevant when structured training, internal communications, collaboration, and enterprise governance matter more than open-ended creative tools.


### D-ID: talking portraits and interactive agents


[D-ID](https://www.d-id.com/) is worth comparing when you need a talking portrait or an interactive, real-time digital-human experience. Its Studio, API, and Visual Agents are different products with different limits.


## Production and rights checklist


- Use portraits, voices, logos, scripts, music, and presentations you have permission to upload and transform.
- Obtain and retain explicit consent before cloning a person's likeness or voice.
- Record the plan, avatar type, language, voice, K-coin quote, script, settings, generation date, and output ID.
- Review every frame, word, caption, claim, link, pronunciation, and disclosure.
- Check current commercial-use, privacy, retention, cancellation, and K-coin expiration terms.
- Do not present an AI avatar as a real customer or employee without clear authorization and disclosure.
- Keep a human owner responsible for factual accuracy and the final export.


## Frequently asked questions


### Is KreadoAI free?


Yes, with limits. The current homepage lists 180 K-coins, three total video minutes, five avatars, 120+ voices, 31 languages, and one instant avatar clone. The dedicated pricing page currently shows a conflicting ten-K-coin figure, so check the logged-in account before planning a project.


### How much does KreadoAI cost?


As checked September 12, 2026, the homepage displays promotional prices of $19/month for Premium and $40/month for Pro. The dedicated pricing page is dynamic and does not expose all paid prices consistently. Verify billing frequency, renewal price, taxes, and K-coins at checkout.


### What are K-coins?


K-coins are KreadoAI's usage currency. The amount deducted depends on the workflow and avatar type. Membership K-coins reset each billing cycle; purchased packs have separate expiration windows.


### Can KreadoAI animate a photo?


Yes. Talking Photo accepts a still portrait and animates it from a script and voice. The help center currently says free users receive three trials and that ordinary Talking Photo video consumes one K-coin per generated second.


### Can KreadoAI clone an avatar?


Yes. Instant Clone starts from a short source video and is included in plan-specific quantities. A separate professional avatar-and-voice service currently costs $499 and requires a longer recording plus review.


### Does KreadoAI have an API?


Yes. KreadoAI documents API access for Professional/Pro users. Its current help page lists one concurrent task by default, a queue of eight, provider-estimated generation speed, and example per-minute costs. Confirm current limits and terms before production use.
